Clear terms

Everything in plain language.

Other hire-train-deploy providers have faced criticism over exit fees and training bonds. We publish ours up front.

For candidates

Training cost, stipend and any bond: confirm and state clearly. Never leave this vague.

For clients

Conversion fee and minimum deployment period: confirm and state clearly.

Outcomes

Cohort sizes, placement rate and time to deploy: publish only what can be evidenced.
